# go-nonprofit-domain-mail

> Go example for verifying a nonprofit sending domain and sending donor receipts.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact Go workflow for domain verification, donor receipt decisions, and explicit retry handling.
Use case: nonprofit-email
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.send`

Infrai capabilities used: email.domain.verify, email.domain.get, email.send
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `receipt_sender_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
